metadata.title: Nowly | Share what you do, in real time
metadata.description: Nowly turns what you watch, listen to, or play into a rich, live Discord presence.

hero.description: Nowly turns your activity into a rich, dynamic Discord presence.

platforms.title: Works with the platforms you already use
platforms.description: Connect your favorite services and Nowly automatically shows what you watch, listen to, or play.

steps.title: Three steps. Then Discord keeps up.
steps.description: The extension reads the tab, the desktop app talks to Discord, and a presence decides what to show.

items.title: The extension
items.text: Add Nowly to Chrome or Firefox.

cta.title: Get started with Nowly
cta.description: Install the extension for free and you're set up in seconds.

features.title: A status that actually feels alive
features.description: Nowly is a browser extension, a desktop app, and a library of signed presence scripts.

items.title: Automatic updates
items.description: Title, artwork, timestamps, and playback state refresh as the page changes.

items.title: Install what you need
items.description: YouTube, Netflix, Twitch, and more. Enable a presence from the library in one click.

items.title: Nothing extra on the page
items.description: Scripts run only on the sites you install, nothing runs anywhere else.

items.title: Signed scripts
items.description: Official presences are verified before they run, so the runtime stays under control.

items.title: Chrome and Firefox
items.description: Works on Chromium browsers and Firefox. The download button follows your browser.

items.title: Desktop app
items.description: The desktop app is the local bridge Discord actually accepts. Windows, macOS, and Linux.

privacy-section.title: Your activity is not our product
privacy-section.description: What you watch stays on your computer. Discord gets the status from your machine, not from nowly.me.

items.title: Nothing goes through our servers
items.description: Extension, desktop app, then Discord. Title, platform, and playback never leave your PC.

items.title: No analytics unless you ask
items.description: If you turn them on, they only help improve Nowly. You can turn them off at any time.

items.title: Only the sites you install
items.description: A presence runs only after you install it. Remove it, and Nowly leaves that site alone.

faq.title: Questions, answered quickly
faq.description: The essentials on install, data, and Discord. Docs and Discord go further.

items.question: What is Nowly?
items.answer: Nowly shows what you watch, listen to, or play as Discord Rich Presence. It is a browser extension, a desktop app, and a library of platform scripts.

items.question: Does my activity go through your servers?
items.answer: No. Activity stays local and is sent to Discord from your machine. Reviews you publish, if any, are stored server-side. Analytics are optional and off by default.

items.question: Which platforms are supported?
items.answer: The live list is the library. New presences can be added without updating the extension, so install the ones you actually use.
